index_headline: Send a secret that automatically disappears after reading
index_subtitle: Your secret is encrypted in your browser, so no one else can read it - not even us. It can only be opened once, with a link and password you share yourself. After that, it's gone for good.
index_how_it_works_step_1: Your message is encrypted in your browser, before it ever leaves your device
index_how_it_works_step_2: Only the encrypted data is uploaded to the server
index_how_it_works_step_3: You share the link and the password with your recipient
index_how_it_works_step_4: Your recipient opens the message, which automatically deletes it.
index_error_creating_drop: We encountered an issue creating your message link. Please try again.
index_drop_made_description: Send the full message below to your recipient - they'll need both the link and the password to open it.
drop_message_2_kicker: I'm sending something secret, that you can get here:
drop_message_6_description_1: This link only works once. Copy the message directly.
drop_message_7_description_2: As soon as it's opened - with the right password or without it - the data is permanently deleted.
drop_message_8_description_3_time: The link also expires after %1$d hours; the data is erased then, too.
pickup_kicker_1: This secret is locked with a password - enter the password that was shared with you.
pickup_kicker_2: This link works only once - after you submit the password, the data is deleted, whether the password was correct or not.
pickup_error_possible_reasons_bullet_poi: The secret has already been opened.
pickup_error_security_warning_text: If you weren't expecting it to be opened yet, treat the message as compromised.
pickup_hint_encrypt_yourself: Want to send your own secret? Click here.
html_meta_description: Send a secret that disappears after it's read - encrypted, one-time, no account needed.
modal_language_description: This setting applies to your page. The recipients of the drops will see the page in their language.
